title: Dichotomy for the Brauer-Manin obstruction in characteristic p
summary: Let X be a smooth, projective, geometrically integral variety over a global function field k of characteristic p. We show that if the unipotent Brauer group of X is zero, and the Picard scheme of X is torsion free, then only finitely many places of k can be potentially relevant to the Brauer--Manin obstruction for X. In the opposite case, almost all places of k are potentially relevant. If X is base changed from a finite field, then in both cases the finite set of exceptional places is empty.
